zusvg: render SVG images without system dependencies

Source: R/zusvg-package.R
zusvg-package.Rd

zusvg renders SVG documents to pixels with bundled copies of the plutosvg and plutovg C libraries, so it installs from source with no system library and draws the same pixels on every platform. It is meant for icons and logos. It does not render text, filters, masks, patterns, markers, CSS style sheets or clip paths; a document that uses them renders without them.
